response.rationale: The presence of a high-grade tumor in the bone marrow biopsy and specific immunohistochemistry markers (CD2, CD3, CD30, perforin, TIA-1) strongly support T-cell lymphoma, while the runner-up candidate (HLH) is supported by fever, elevated ferritin, and cytopenias, but lacks specific diagnostic criteria and hemophagocytosis in the bone marrow biopsy.
